title: Crispy Pork Tacos
description: Tender pork, crunchy slaw, and a hint of sweetness make for a mouth-watering taco.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the pork shoulder with quesadilla seasoning.
Cook the pork shoulder in the skillet until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a plate and let it rest.
Warm the honeyed tortillas in the skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Shred the pork shoulder into bite-sized pieces.
Assemble the tacos with shredded pork, oaxacan cheese, crunchy slaw, and a squeeze of lime juice.
